szenen.text: EVAA is at {preis}. That is {fach} times its low from two weeks ago. So where is the liquidity?
szenen.text_ohne: EVAA went vertical in two weeks. So where is the liquidity?

szenen.text: On the right: our estimated liquidation map. Red, the long liquidations, are stacked far below the price. Green, the short liquidations, sit right above it.
szenen.text_ohne: Long liquidations are stacked far below the price. Short liquidations sit right above it.

szenen.text: And the all-time high? {{hoch}}. EVAA is now {{vom_hoch}} away from it.
szenen.text_ohne: And the all-time high is still above the price.

szenen.text: Our view: above the price there is little in the way, and short liquidations are stacked up there. We think EVAA has room to run.
